prose: The headline, from Techmeme, says sources describe Mark Zuckerberg deciding to launch Meta's Muse agent despite safety concerns, after seeing that a similar agent product from the startup Instinct was gaining traction.
Basis: the underlying report was blocked (HTTP 403), so this relies on the headline only. The reporting outlet, the safety concerns and the timeline are not confirmed here.
highlights: Zuckerberg reportedly launched Muse despite safety concerns
Triggered by a rival agent product gaining traction
